title: tegnap and Other Past Time Words

sections.title: Marking when, not just what
sections.content: tegnap ("yesterday") is the anchor word for this whole unit. Like reggel and este, it needs no extra suffix — just put it at the front of the sentence, the same slot where you already put jövő héten or szombaton. Combine it with reggel/este to narrow down which part of yesterday you mean, or with egész nap to say the whole day.

items.english: I watched a film yesterday evening.
I got up early yesterday morning.

sections.content: aztán ("then, after that") lets you chain two past actions in one sentence without a new connector to learn: Tegnap dolgoztam, aztán filmet néztem ("I worked yesterday, then I watched a film"). You'll use it constantly once you start telling longer stories about your day.
